label: Hellenistic
note: Greco-Egyptian foundation: houses, sect, lots, and the first time-lord systems.

label: Perso-Arabic (medieval)
note: Transmission and extension of Hellenistic method: firdaria, expanded lots, receptions.

label: Renaissance
note: Latin and vernacular consolidation; Lilly's horary and natal practice.

label: Modern
note: Revival from the Theosophical era onward: outer planets, psychological reading.

label: Jyotisa
note: Indian sidereal tradition: nakshatras, vargas, dashas, yogas.
